transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having trouble sitting still. Whenever I'm supposed to just sit there, like in staff meetings at work, or... church event briefings. It feels like I've got a motor humming under my skin. I usually end up shifting around a lot, or I just have to find some excuse to stand up and move.
When you feel this need to move, do you feel an overwhelming, uncomfortable physical sensation in your legs that is relieved by moving them?
No... not really. It's not an uncomfortable feeling in my legs, exactly. I just... I just need to get up. That's about it.
Did you experience these feelings of needing to move or being unable to sit still when you were a child?

Yeah... I guess so. Got in trouble for it back in grade school a few times. Just... popping out of my seat, mostly. Or I'd, uh, talk over the teacher... rush ahead before they finished giving directions. My mother used to say I acted like I was wound too tight. So... yeah, even as a kid.
